source.description: Hand-authored push-limit controls: 12 honey +12 adjacent bases; 12 honey +one base; one honey +12 adjacent bases; 12 honey +two bases (13-block load). Only the last base receives power.

action_boundary: immediately before the numbered tick; initial snapshot is tick zero
server_kind: Minecraft GameTestServer; no client or connected players
scope: tick-end blocks, comparator outputs and simple occupied slot IDs/counts; no entity, item-component, moving-BE or intra-tick equality
